mapper.sql: SELECT c.collection_id, c.account_id, c.name, c.parent_collection_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question q WHERE q.account_id = c.account_id AND q.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS question_count FROM question_collection c
mapper.select: INSERT INTO question_collection(account_id, name, parent_collection_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{name}, #{parentCollectionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT (account_id, (COALESCE(parent_collection_id, 0)), name) DO NOTHING RETURNING collection_id
mapper.update: UPDATE question_collection SET name = #{name} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND collection_id = #{collectionId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_collection WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND collection_id = #{collectionId})
